## The bar (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] It is live: used for real work, source changed in the last 12 months
- [ ] It does one job, and the summary names that job
- [ ] It is not a near-duplicate of a listed skill (CI checks this too)
- [ ] Its licence allows redistribution, or it is marked `link-only`
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally

Every listing is merged by hand. Nothing goes live until it is.
